title: Large-scale harmonic measures and nontangential maximal functions in periodic homogenization
summary: In this paper, we consider the elliptic operators $\mathcal{L}_\varepsilon = -\nabla\cdot (A(X/\varepsilon) \nabla )$ with periodic coefficients in a bounded domain $Ω$ without any local smoothness assumption on $A = A(Y)$, where $\varepsilon \ll \text{diam}(Ω)$ is a microscopic scale. Due to the irregularity of the coefficients at $\varepsilon$ scale, we introduce the correct forms of the large-scale nontangential maximal functions for the Dirichlet, Neumann and regularity problems that measure the behaviors of solutions at an $\varepsilon$ distance away from the boundary.
